rows.question: How long does standard delivery to Germany take, and how much does it cost?
rows.answer: Standard delivery to Germany takes 3–5 business days and costs €6.90 [1].

rows.question: Can I return an unopened bag of cat food, and how long do I have?
rows.answer: You can return an unopened bag of cat food within 30 days of the delivery date, as long as it is unused, unopened, and in its original packaging [1].

rows.question: My dog refuses the PawPantry Kitchen food I opened last week. Can I get my money back?
rows.answer: Yes, you can get a refund if your dog refuses to eat food from the PawPantry Kitchen range even if the bag is opened, provided you contact PawPantry within 14 days of delivery, at least half the bag is left, and you have not used the Happy Tummy Promise for the same product before. You do not need to send the food back; just send a photo of the bag showing the batch number and remaining contents to get a full refund [1].

rows.question: If I pay by bank transfer, how long do you hold my order and when does it ship?
rows.answer: If you pay by bank transfer, we hold your items for 7 calendar days. If the payment has not arrived by then, the order is cancelled. Your order ships once the money reaches our account, which usually takes 1–2 business days after you send the transfer [1][2].

rows.question: How do I skip or pause my Autoship, and what is the deadline for changes?
rows.answer: You can skip your next delivery with one click, or pause the whole Autoship for up to 6 months under My account → Autoship. Changes, including skipping or pausing, must be made by 23:59 CET on the day before the processing date. Pausing restarts automatically at the end of the pause and you receive a reminder 3 days before. Skipping only affects the next delivery; the following one stays on schedule [1].

rows.question: How often should I replace the filter in the AquaFlow fountain? I have two cats.
rows.answer: For two cats, you should replace the carbon filter every 2 weeks, as the filter replacement frequency is every 4 weeks for one pet but every 2 weeks for more than one pet or if pets shed a lot [1].

rows.question: How much dry food should my 10 kg adult dog eat per day?
rows.answer: A 10 kg adult dog should eat 160 grams of PawPantry Kitchen dry food per day, split into two meals. Adjustments include adding 10-20% for very active or working dogs, and reducing by about 10% for neutered dogs or those over 8 years old [1].

rows.question: My SmartBowl feeder stopped working 18 months after delivery. Is it still covered?
rows.answer: If your SmartBowl feeder stopped working 18 months after delivery, it depends on the length of the original warranty period for your product. After a repair or replacement, coverage continues for the remainder of the original warranty period or for 6 months, whichever is longer [1]. However, batteries are covered for only 6 months [2]. Also, accidental damage and damage not following the care guide are not covered [3][2]. The website does not provide the exact original warranty length, so verify your purchase details for that information.

rows.question: Can I chat with you on Saturdays, and until what time?
rows.answer: Yes, you can chat with us on Saturdays until 17:00 CET via live chat [1][2].

rows.question: Combien de temps ai-je pour retourner un article ?
rows.answer: Vous pouvez retourner la plupart des articles dans les 30 jours suivant la date de livraison, tant qu'ils sont inutilisés, non ouverts et dans leur emballage d'origine. Pour les commandes livrées en plusieurs colis, les 30 jours commencent à partir de la livraison de chaque colis [1].

rows.question: What is the heavy-order surcharge for a 25 kg order shipped to Spain?
rows.answer: For orders weighing more than 20 kg, a heavy-order surcharge of €10 is added at checkout for countries other than France, including Spain [1].

rows.question: Do you sell gift cards, and how long are they valid?
rows.answer: Yes, PawPantry sells digital gift cards. According to passage [1], they offer gift cards of €25, €50, and €100 valid for 2 years from purchase. Passage [2] states gift cards are available from €10 to €250 and are valid for 24 months (which is 2 years) from purchase.

rows.question: Do you have a shop in Lyon I can visit?
rows.answer: PawPantry does not have a physical shop; it is an online shop only, and orders ship from our logistics centre in Lyon, France. You can collect orders free of charge at the logistics centre, but it is not a shop and products cannot be bought on site or returned there [1][2].
